<a id="task-026"></a>

### TASK-026 — Publish a MicroVM environment once and create it on another Node by the same artifact revision

Done · `feature` · `maintainer`

- Capabilities: CAP-PUBLICATION, CAP-ENV-BINDING, CAP-STORAGE
- Dependencies: TASK-005, TASK-025
- Increment: Deliver a manifest independent of host absolute paths. The receiving Node verifies objects in its store and creates its own deployment entry. Callers request the published revision.
- Reuse: Reuse object digests, atomic publication, Node environment claims, Placement, IAM and Edge checks. Retain prior 3FS and enrollment evidence.
- Trigger: At bc4783b the same source published to A and B had matching digests for four payload types but different deployment revisions. Copying A's catalog and removing A's store failed even though B had identical content, because references still pointed to A. Name-only placement selected by load.
- Prior evidence: EV-R3-1008, EV-FLEET, EV-ENV-1030, EV-PACK-DIFF-OVERLAYBD-1124
- Resources: Local stores and the control plane can verify identity. Two independent Node instances with Linux KVM/ublk suffice for functional acceptance. A second qualified Linux Node is needed for a cross-physical-host claim.
- Acceptance: Publish once on A. B registers the same artifact identity at a different path from trusted manifests and visible objects. Preserve layer order and execution config. Verification failure prevents publication. / Exclude a less busy Node with the same name but the wrong revision. If no Node matches, hold no quota. Retries preserve the owner and trusted deployment revision. / Create a derived MicroVM on B through the public SDK. Execute the dependency, pause, resume, stop and verify cleanup on B. Record physical host and logical Node counts.
- Stop condition: Record artifact handoff, revision enforcement, SDK creation, recovery and release on B. Live cross-host migration and independent-domain HA remain separate.
- Completion evidence: EV-PORTABLE-MICROVM-1124

- Changed boundary: Introduce portable artifact identity and placement by that identity. Keep Node/Edge checks on the existing deployment revision. Resume still returns a paused instance to its original owner.
